summary: PR #271 exposed a current-main Swarm Control Plane regression unrelated to WorldEntity: trusted PR ownership materialization copies swarmctl.py and swarmctl_hardening.py, but main@914d0a2f makes swarmctl_hardening.py import swarmctl_hardening_base. The pr-ownership job therefore aborts with ModuleNotFoundError before validating any live claim, potentially blocking all product PR ownership checks.
evidence: PR #271 Swarm Control Plane run 31464525682: engine-tests PASS, pr-ownership FAIL.
pr-ownership job 93694532591 fails at trusted swarmctl_hardening.py import with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'swarmctl_hardening_base'.
Current main 914d0a2f is the V2.1 facade commit; the failing workflow materializes only swarmctl.py and swarmctl_hardening.py before invocation.
